title: VaultSigningResponse
description: The vault daemon's answer to a signing-request.v1 over the ADR-004 process boundary: the signed artifact or a coded refusal. Narrower than signing-response.v1 (which is the pipeline/browser-level response, carries lifecycle state and audit head): the daemon knows nothing of the pipeline lifecycle and holds no audit log. Never contains key material. v1.1 (protocol v0.4, additive): signature_hex carries the raw signature for typed_data/personal_message payload kinds (raw_tx_hex/tx_hash stay null for those; signature_hex stays null for evm_transaction).

raw_tx_hex.description: broadcastable signed transaction; present iff state=SIGNED and kind=evm_transaction

signature_hex.description: v1.1: present iff state=SIGNED and kind=typed_data|personal_message (65-byte r/s/v signature)

code.description: VLT-LCK-001 locked · VLT-CAP-001 capability · VLT-POL-001 policy deny · VLT-POL-002 unacknowledged escalation · VLT-CHN-001 non-development chain · VLT-ACC-001 account mismatch · VLT-KEY-001 real key forbidden · VLT-SIG-001 signer error · VLT-USR-001 rejected at the Vault-side confirmation surface · VLT-SUR-001 confirmation surface unavailable or failed integrity (fail closed) · VLT-MSG-001 malformed typed_data/personal_message payload (v0.4; the Vault could not independently re-derive what it was asked to sign)
